description.value: A full-service private campground managed by the K'ómoks First Nation, set along the Puntledge River and within a 10-15 minute walk of downtown Courtenay; showers, laundry, and a camp store on site, but note that the lower campground and river access are currently closed for ongoing construction.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content was fully fetched and is rich; it corroborates all OSM contact fields. Amenities confirmed directly from website text include showers ('onsite washrooms with showers'), coin laundry, an on-site convenience/camp store, sitewide Wi-Fi, and online booking. A Spring 2026 construction notice confirms the lower campground and river access are temporarily closed, but the upper campground with 82 full-hookup sites remains operational; no hiker/biker-specific site category or cyclist-specific amenities (pump, tools, e-bike charging) are mentioned anywhere on the site.
concerns: Lower campground and on-site river access are currently closed due to construction as of Spring 2026; upper campground (82 full-hookup sites) remains open.
OSM name records 'Puntledge RV Park and Campground' while the website consistently uses 'Puntledge RV Park & Campground' — minor typographic discrepancy.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A legitimate, actively operating campground with tent sites, showers, coin laundry, on-site store, and online booking, located within walking distance of downtown Courtenay — a useful and well-equipped stop for touring cyclists on Vancouver Island.
enrichment_extras.notes: Campground is owned and operated by the K'ómoks First Nation on unceded traditional K'ómoks territory. The about page and on-site store feature interpretive material on Pentlatch and K'ómoks history, which may interest culturally curious touring cyclists.

wow_evidence: managed by the K'ómoks First Nation… showers, laundry, and a camp store on site
